chores.name: main-tip
chores.probe: R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { echo "PROBE-ERR: not in a git checkout"; exit 1; }; git -C "$R" rev-parse --short origin/main
chores.full: R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { echo "PROBE-ERR: not in a git checkout"; exit 1; }; git -C "$R" log --oneline -1 origin/main

chores.name: pr-states
chores.probe: gh pr list --state open --json number,statusCheckRollup --jq "[.[]|{n:.number,r:([.statusCheckRollup[]?|select(.conclusion==\"FAILURE\")]|length>0)}]|sort_by(.n)|map(\"\(.n):\(if .r then \"RED\" else \"green\" end)\")|join(\" \")"
chores.full: gh pr list --state open --json number,statusCheckRollup --jq "[.[]|{n:.number,r:([.statusCheckRollup[]?|select(.conclusion==\"FAILURE\")]|length>0)}]|sort_by(.n)|map(\"#\(.n) \(if .r then \"RED\" else \"green\" end)\")|join(\", \")"

chores.name: root-untracked
chores.probe:
R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { echo "PROBE-ERR: not in a git checkout"; exit 1; }; S=$(git -C "$R" status --porcelain -uall) || { echo "PROBE-ERR: git status failed"; exit 1; }; U=$(printf "%s
" "$S" | grep "^??" | sort); echo "$(printf "%s" "$U" | grep -c .) untracked of $(printf "%s
" "$S" | grep -c .) rows: $(printf "%s" "$U" | tr "
" " ")"
chores.full: R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel) || { echo "PROBE-ERR: not in a git checkout"; exit 1; }; S=$(git -C "$R" status --porcelain -uall) || { echo "PROBE-ERR: git status failed"; exit 1; }; printf "%s\n" "$S" | grep "^??" | sed "s/^?? /untracked: /"; echo "examined $(printf "%s\n" "$S" | grep -c .) rows"

removals.name: pr-states
removals.reason: reauthoring with --full so deltas are relayable, not just detectable
